title: Executed register-defect census
scope: Ordinary Law C load runs with the declared passive Z6 register; screen and internal tiers stay separate.

interpretation.identity: qL, qR and lepton are candidate centre-class names. These rows do not identify Standard Model species, generation, spin statistics, mass or measured interaction amplitudes.
interpretation.birth: Defects are zero in the preparation, then born when current-driven register twists are accepted. This is event-born structure during an iid-load quench, not a simulation of vacuum pair production or reheating.
interpretation.freeze: Once loads balance, moved unit currents release zero mismatch potential. Positive-cost register proposals are rejected. Surviving defects can therefore be pinned by the declared cost barrier; this is not cosmological thermal freeze-out.
interpretation.clock: Causal depth defines a consistent cut, incident ticks count all local seam attempts, sweeps count solver work. None is calibrated to cosmological seconds by these run files.
interpretation.population: GEN lifetime modes mix short reactions, later reactions and right-censored survivors. GEN does not establish three particle generations.
interpretation.geometry: Use stored cut screen_xyz for actual positions. Birth-to-last interpolation is not a trajectory; random placement is an illustration. Sample counts must not be presented as reconstructed whole-run histories.

sources.title: PDG 2025 Big-Bang Cosmology
sources.sections: 22.3.1-22.3.3: thermal distributions, relativistic degrees of freedom, equilibrium versus expansion

sources.title: PDG 2025 Inflation
sources.sections: 23.2.2 and 23.6: reheating and its model dependence

sources.title: NASA LAMBDA: Cosmic Microwave Background
sources.sections: CMB temperature anisotropies at about 380,000 years

standard_cosmology.reheating: In inflationary scenarios, field energy transfers to particles and thermalizes. Its duration, temperature and initial products depend on the reheating model; all Standard Model species need not be produced simultaneously.
standard_cosmology.uniformity: Large-scale near homogeneity is part of the cosmological reconstruction. The observed anisotropy of order 1e-5 refers to CMB temperature at last scattering, not an instantaneous uniformity measurement at reheating.
standard_cosmology.hot_plasma: For a thermalized Standard Model plasma well above the electroweak scale, all Standard Model degrees of freedom are approximately relativistic. The unbroken electroweak gauge basis is B and W^a; the low-temperature photon/Z basis is not used here.

thermal_weights.scope: Ideal relativistic equilibrium, common temperature, negligible chemical potentials; no right-handed neutrinos included.

groups.label: left chiral quark fields and their antiparticles
right chiral quark fields and their antiparticles

standard_cosmology.freeze_out: Thermal freeze-out compares an interaction rate with the cosmic expansion rate. The passive register's zero-work cost barrier is a different mechanism.

runs.name: L3
runs.regime: quench: the seeded loads carry variance 35/12 per port against 1/4 in the balanced band; block totals are conserved, so after the balanced class is reached the long density modes are still far from the canonical equilibrium and relax at rate 2 lambda_k in scaled time tau = sweeps / (2 * 4^level); statistics of this run are quench statistics
